title: Law 3A Probe v2: Pure High-D Non-Local Orphan Transport in Haar-Rotated R^32
intuition: Cleanly isolates Law 3A high-D non-local orphan transport in Haar-rotated R^32 (dim=32 > 16) by decoupling full-32D covariance rank into `fl_law1_highd_rank_d32_v2`: requires capturing all 5 clusters including the distant 8% orphan with accurate masses and precision >= 0.85.
failure_mode: Transport heuristics capped at low ambient dimensions (dim <= 16) or tight screening horizons leave the distant 8% orphan mode uncaptured (orphan_recall = 0).
protocol_notes: Four Laws Adherence v2 diagnostic probe (1,200 updates, Haar-rotated R^32, 5 modes + 8% distant orphan).
